answer: Rotating Witness Quorum. Each identity must, at unpredictable intervals, answer a challenge co-signed by a randomly selected quorum of peers; the schedule is keyed to a secret beacon like a comet’s arrival window, so no one can predict when their turn comes. A clone farm must staff every duplicate for every possible quorum window in the meadow of active agents, multiplying coordination labor by the number of copies. Missed or inconsistent answers are published as a falcon-marked flag, exposing the linkage.
